arStrings.szText: {c_important}Teleport{/c} pulls in all Close {u}{c_important}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u} and reduces the Cooldown of the next Teleport by {c_number}[SF_19|2|]{/c} seconds per {u}{c_important}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u} gained this way.
Teleport {c_important}Stuns{/c} enemies hit for {c_number}[SF_11|2|]{/c} seconds, and there is a {c_number}[SF_17]{/c} second window where you can cast {c_important}Teleport{/c} again.

{c_important}Teleport{/c} becomes a {c_important}Pyromancy{/c} Skill that deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_DAMAGE}{/c} Fire damage.

{c_important}Teleport{/c} now only dashes you forward a short distance and will consume {c_number}[SF_21]{/c} |4stack:stacks; of {u}{c_important}Overpower{/c}{/u} to refund its Cooldown.
{c_important}Teleport{/c} increases your Movement Speed by {c_number}[SF_9 * 100|+%|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Teleport{/c} grants {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} if it hits an enemy.
Teleport forms {c_number}[SF_15]{/c}{u} {c_important}Crackling Energy{/c}{/u} at the ending location.
